ordersPerDay.below: Demand problem: 3x budget on best creative (04 §5 scale rule); check runner supply first — if match-time p95 > 5 min it is a SUPPLY problem, recruit before spending on demand.

completionRate.below: Funnel leak: check no-runner-found rate vs cancellations; if no-runner > 5%, run runner SMS blast + raise surge cap; if buyer cancels, audit quote accuracy.

cac.below: Winner: shift budget from losing ad sets; clone creative to next city waitlist.
cac.above: Kill creatives over $12 CAC (04 §5); shift spend to referral bonus which is capped-cost by design.

runnerUtil.below: Too many runners idle: pause runner recruiting, push demand; below 1.0 runners will churn.
runnerUtil.above: Above 2.5: match times will degrade — resume runner recruiting this week.

referralShare.below: Push post-delivery share card; test $10/$10 weekend boost (still cheaper than paid CAC).

takeRate.outside: Fee math drift — audit pricing engine vs Stripe payouts immediately (should never happen; possible bug or refund spike).
